 Open Navigation Menu Menu Search Search News GTA VI Is Putting on a Music Festival
 Sure, why not By Jazz Monroe November 9, 2026 GTA VI Banners in Hong Kong (Getty Images) Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Comment Loader Save Story Save this story Not content with securing an original Justice score, anything-goes soundtrack , and bundle of superstar-curated radio stations , Rockstar Games has announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival. Coming to Miami’s premier convention center, Mana Wynwood, on the alarmingly near date of November 21, the one-dayer is set to be headlined by Travis Scott and friends (billed as Cactus Jack), Cardi B , and CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso . Sets from Justice and Metro Boomin take second billing, alongside an undercard that includes local boy Nick León playing back to back with DJ Python. Take a look at the poster below and stay tuned for further enterprises from our GTA VI overlords.
 Don Toliver, Kodak Black, and Sofaygo will join Scott for the Cactus Jack headliner, while Rauw Alejandro will bring along some surprise guests for another spin on the posse set. Fellow Puerto Rican Tainy is also on the bill, along with two more back-to-back DJ sets: the Dare B2B Fcukers and Prospa B2B Skream. Suero, the collaborative project of Jubilee, Berrakka, and Jonny From Space, complete the bill.
